items.title: Invoice and card requests may trust a customer id supplied by the browser
Sign-in link stays usable for 7 days, so anyone who sees the email becomes the customer
The sign-in secret travels in a URL and leaks through browser history, referrers and logs
Card on file can be replaced using only a sign-in link, with no second check
Public sign-in form reveals which email addresses have billing accounts
Invoice pages cached by browsers and shared proxies expose billing data after the session ends
Card-on-file changes are recorded with no evidence of which link or device made them
